entities.name: Query protein 93 aa
observations: 93-residue protein; calculated molecular mass 10.24 kDa, pI 4.57, and predicted net charge about -5.5 at pH 7.
Shows 68.5–70.7% identity over approximately 99% of its length to reviewed pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase 2 proteins.
Likely catalyzes reversible phosphorolysis of nucleosides to D-ribose 1-phosphate and free bases; exact substrate range is inferred from homologs.

entities.name: Q4FTI5
observations: Reviewed Psychrobacter arcticus pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase 2; 70.7% identity and 98.9% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated for guanosine, thymidine, and uridine phosphorylase activities and cytosolic localization.
